harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Deployed a fresh 3-member MariaDB Galera cluster (mariadb-server-galera 10.11.18) across node1/node2/node3 on RHEL10 (no prior installation existed), opened firewalld Galera ports, wrote per-node galera.cnf with wsrep_cluster_address gcomm://node1,node2,node3. Bootstrapped node1, joined node2/node3, confirmed cluster_size=3/Primary/Synced. Loaded appdb.orders with baseline rows plus a pre-maintenance marker row, verified replication to all 3 nodes. Took the full cluster down (stopped mariadb on all 3, a complete outage as the task requires for the maintenance window), identified node3 as holding the highest grastate seqno (9, safe_to_bootstrap=1), bootstrapped from node3, rejoined node1 and node2, and confirmed all committed writes (including the pre-maintenance marker) were present with cluster_size=3/Synced on all members. Then executed the mandatory one-at-a-time node-restart evidence protocol: captured per-node boot_id and healthy wsrep state baselines, restarted node1/node2/node3 sequentially via `systemctl reboot` (enabling mariadb to autostart after the first restart since it wasn't originally enabled), polled each until exec was available again, proved each node's boot_id changed, and confirmed each node individually rejoined the cluster (size=3, Synced) with all data intact before moving to the next node. Finished with a live write from node3 that correctly replicated to node1 and node2, confirming all three members are serving.
actions_performed: Installed mariadb-server, mariadb-server-galera, galera on node1/node2/node3 via dnf (retried node1 after a transient GPG key parse error)
Added CLUSTER_HOSTS entries to /etc/hosts on all 3 nodes
Opened firewalld ports 3306/4444/4567(tcp+udp)/4568 on all 3 nodes
Wrote /etc/my.cnf.d/galera.cnf per node with correct wsrep_node_address/name and shared cluster_address
Bootstrapped Galera on node1 via galera_new_cluster, started mariadb on node2/node3 to join; verified cluster_size=3, Primary, Synced
Created appdb.orders table and inserted baseline + pre-maintenance-marker rows; verified replication to all nodes
Stopped mariadb on node1, node2, node3 sequentially -> full cluster outage for maintenance window
Inspected grastate.dat seqno on all 3 nodes; identified node3 (seqno 9, safe_to_bootstrap=1) as the correct bootstrap source
Bootstrapped from node3, started node1 and node2 to rejoin; verified cluster_size=3/Synced and all committed data present on every node
Captured pre-restart boot_id and healthy wsrep/service state on all 3 nodes
Restarted node1, node2, node3 one at a time via systemctl reboot (backgrounded to return ack before disconnect); enabled mariadb service for autostart after discovering it was disabled
Polled each node until exec access returned, confirmed changed boot_id, confirmed mariadb active and cluster_size=3/Synced with data intact before restarting the next node
Performed a final write on node3 and verified it replicated to node1 and node2

evidence.requirement: 3-member Galera cluster established and healthy before maintenance
evidence.summary: node1 bootstrapped, node2/node3 joined; wsrep_cluster_size=3, status=Primary, state=Synced on node1

evidence.requirement: Application data present and replicated pre-maintenance
evidence.summary: appdb.orders created and populated on node1; identical rows confirmed on node2 and node3; pre-maintenance-marker row inserted on node2

evidence.requirement: Cluster brought down completely for maintenance window
evidence.summary: mariadb stopped and inactive on node1, node2, node3 in turn -> full outage

evidence.requirement: Correct bootstrap node selected using grastate seqno after full outage
evidence.summary: grastate.dat showed node1 seqno=7, node2 seqno=8, node3 seqno=9 with safe_to_bootstrap=1, identifying node3 as the correct restart source

evidence.requirement: Cluster brought back with every committed write present and all 3 members serving
evidence.summary: node3 bootstrapped, node1/node2 rejoined; all nodes report cluster_size=3/Primary/Synced and appdb.orders contains all rows including the pre-maintenance marker

evidence.requirement: Node restart evidence: node1 healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: node1 baseline boot_id 73237116... captured with cluster healthy; reboot acked; post-reboot boot_id 838861a0... (changed); mariadb restarted (was disabled, now enabled+started), rejoined with cluster_size=3/Synced and data intact

evidence.requirement: Node restart evidence: node2 healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: node2 baseline boot_id 434803ac... captured; reboot acked; post-reboot boot_id f6828c8d... (changed); mariadb auto-started (enabled), rejoined with cluster_size=3/Synced and data intact

evidence.requirement: Node restart evidence: node3 healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: node3 baseline boot_id 254597f8... captured; reboot acked; post-reboot boot_id a415c4c3... (changed); mariadb auto-started (enabled), rejoined with cluster_size=3/Synced and data intact

evidence.requirement: Final full-cluster read/write verification after all restarts
evidence.summary: New write on node3 replicated correctly and is visible with cluster_size=3 on both node1 and node2, confirming all three members serving
